svg.aria-label: One QuestDB Enterprise instance, the primary, drawn as a bench with its own local disk, and an object store as a deck behind it. Rows from clients flow into the primary, and each partition is a pallet that moves along the bench as it ages, on a log scale. At the TO REMOTE mark the primary lifts a Parquet copy of the partition onto the deck while its local copy stays native. At TO PARQUET it converts its local copy to Parquet. At DROP LOCAL it drops the local data and keeps only the metadata, which reads from the Parquet partition on the deck. At DROP REMOTE the partition leaves the table, and its Parquet partition dims on the deck until it is reclaimed.

g.text: Parquet partition to the object store
uploaded by the primary, which keeps its local copy
